sentences: rs1426654 is a missense variant in SLC24A5 (p.Thr111Ala) [F2].
The alternate G allele (A>G) is observed at 8.1% of alleles in gnomAD v4 exomes and at 30% of alleles in gnomAD v4 genomes, reflecting the different population compositions of the call sets [F3].
Within the exome data the G allele frequency ranges from 99% in East Asian individuals to 0.2% in European (non‑Finnish) individuals [F5].
ClinVar classifies this variant as benign, and it has been discussed in the context of the light‑skin allele shared by South Asians and Europeans (Basu Mallick C et al. 2013) [F6, F7].
